description: Exhaustive repository of mathematical equations, input variables, benchmarks, and interpretation logic for marketing analytics and financial/operational management.

marketing_and_unit_economics.name: Customer Lifetime Value (Steady Retention)

Churn_Rate.description: Lost customers in period / Total customers at start

marketing_and_unit_economics.benchmark: CLV / CAC >= 3.0 (Viable SaaS/E-commerce); CLV / CAC < 1.0 (Value Destruction)
marketing_and_unit_economics.interpretation: Quantifies upper limit of allowable marketing acquisition spend per customer.

Total_Marketing_Expenses.description: Ad spend, agency fees, content production costs

marketing_and_unit_economics.name: Content Marketing Return on Investment

Attributed_Gross_Profit.description: Revenue attributed to content * Gross Margin %

Content_Production_Costs.description: Writer fees, video production, graphic design, distribution tech

marketing_and_unit_economics.benchmark: Organic SEO content typically achieves 250% - 600% ROI over 18-month lifecycle.

S_Engage.description: Weighted Likes, Comments, Shares, Saves against Views

S_Growth.description: Profile visits and Follow conversion rate per 10k views

S_Retention_Quality.description: 3-second view rate, Completion Rate, Average Watch Duration

corporate_finance.name: Weighted Average Cost of Capital
corporate_finance.equation: WACC = (E / V) * Ke + (D / V) * Kd * (1 - Tc)

Tc.description: Corporate Income Tax Rate (e.g., 0.20 in Vietnam)

corporate_finance.benchmark: Serves as discount hurdle rate for capital budgeting (NPV/IRR).

Beta.description: Systematic market volatility risk of the asset

corporate_finance.name: Net Present Value

CF_t.description: Net Cash Flow at year t

corporate_finance.benchmark: NPV > 0 -> Accept project; NPV < 0 -> Reject project

corporate_finance.name: Cash Conversion Cycle

DSO.description: Days Sales Outstanding = (Accounts Receivable / Total Credit Sales) * 365

DPO.description: Days Payable Outstanding = (Accounts Payable / Cost of Goods Sold) * 365

corporate_finance.benchmark: Negative CCC means operations funded entirely by vendor float (e.g., Mixue, Walmart, Apple).

corporate_finance.name: Discounted Cash Flow Multi-Stage Enterprise Valuation
corporate_finance.equation: EV = Sum_{t=1}^n [ FCFF_t / (1 + WACC)^t ] + [ (FCFF_{n+1} / (WACC - g)) / (1 + WACC)^n ]

FCFF_t.description: Free Cash Flow to Firm = EBIT*(1-T) + D&A - Capex - Delta_NWC

g.description: Perpetual terminal growth rate (typically <= GDP growth rate)

managerial_accounting_and_control.name: Break-Even Point in Units

Fixed_Costs.description: Rent, permanent salaries, depreciation, baseline overhead

Unit_Variable_Cost.description: Direct materials, direct packaging, sales commission per unit (VC)

managerial_accounting_and_control.benchmark: Safety Margin = (Current Sales - BEP Sales) / Current Sales >= 20% (Low Risk)

managerial_accounting_and_control.name: DuPont Return on Equity 3-Way Decomposition

Financial_Leverage.description: Total Assets / Total Equity (Capital Structure multiplier)

managerial_accounting_and_control.diagnostic_utility: Pinpoints whether ROE improvement is driven by operational efficiency, sales velocity, or high debt risk.

operations_research_and_supply_chain.name: Little's Law of Process Physics

WIP.description: Work In Progress in the system

Flow_Time.description: Total lead time from entry to exit

operations_research_and_supply_chain.implication: To reduce delivery time without lowering output, the system MUST aggressively cap WIP.

operations_research_and_supply_chain.name: Economic Order Quantity (Wilson Formula)

Setup_Cost_Per_Order.description: Fixed administrative and freight ordering cost (S)

operations_research_and_supply_chain.benchmark: Minimizes Total Annual Inventory Cost (Ordering Cost + Holding Cost).

operations_research_and_supply_chain.name: PERT Three-Point Project Duration Estimation
operations_research_and_supply_chain.application: Enables probabilistic critical path analysis (Z-score for project deadline compliance).
